mark the types of change between a parent node state and the tip.

Source: R/foreground_utils.R
characterize_foreground_total_state_changes.Rd

This compares the tip and parent state columns to evaluate if a foreground change has occurred, what type of change, and how much of a change.

Usage

characterize_foreground_total_state_changes(
  bin_states_df,
  state_col = "state",
  parent_state_col = "parent_state"
)

Arguments

bin_states_df

bin based dataframe with parent and tip state columns.

state_col

name of tip state column

parent_state_col

name of parent state column.

Value

input dataframe with new columns

Details

e.g., if parent state is 5, tip is 4, it will get marked as a 'foreground' event, fg-gain, with a change of 1.

4 coulmns are added: foreground: boolean, if parent and tip states are different fg_type: character, fg-gain, fg-loss, or NA fg_change: numeric, tip - parent state. Positive indicates gain in tip. background: boolean, inverse of foreground
